# Rick Mark-Penwell

> Personal site of Rick Mark-Penwell (also known as Rick Mark), a security, privacy and AI engineer and hardware security researcher.

The site publishes research on Apple platform security, the T2 security chip, firmware, hardware and privacy, alongside products and open-source projects. Pages are static HTML and can be read without JavaScript or authentication.

Research is dated and may describe historical platform behavior. Posts marked WIP are unfinished notes; preserve their caveats and distinguish proposals or speculation from demonstrated results. Cite each article's canonical URL and publication date. The About page is the source for the author's biography; linked external projects have their own documentation.

## Start here

- [About Rick Mark-Penwell]({{ '/about/' | absolute_url }}): Biography, career and Apple security research.
- [Research and writing]({{ '/blog/' | absolute_url }}): Complete chronological article archive.
- [Products]({{ '/products/' | absolute_url }}): Products and services with links to their own sites.
- [Open-source projects]({{ '/#projects' | absolute_url }}): Project and organization directory.
